entities.summary: Kelsey Ann Smith was a teenager from Overland Park, Kansas who was abducted after concluding a shopping trip at Target on June 2, 2007, and was murdered that evening. The story was featured in the international media, including on America's Most Wanted, before her body was found near a lake in Missouri on June 6, 2007.
